scope: Working presentation controls for the passive screen-positioned voice widget and its labeled sample preview; not game-window-aware overlay acceptance.
implementation: Small/large avatars, always/speaking/hidden names, always/speaking participant filtering and a 0-Off through 25 participant cap affect the actual renderer and preview. AppLayout sends the exact validated native fields and at most 64 source participants; Off hides the widget without changing the master preference.

All nine overlay preferences are device-local in both sync directions. Historical account data is not deleted; cached pending overlay patches are filtered while unrelated audio preferences continue synchronizing. Local choices survive account reset and server hydration.
Malformed legacy local values and nonfinite numeric edits are repaired before they can stall the strict IPC contract. Defaults are small avatars, always-visible names and maximum 25 participants.

The shared stylesheet is explicitly loaded by the overlay entry. Rows use border-box 36/48px heights, bounded ellipsized names and transform-aware width limits. A pure native geometry helper sizes and positions the window before display and clamps to the primary display workarea, including negative origins; the effective row cap can fall below the configured maximum when physical space is insufficient.
